item.title: Mount Pleasant’s Jason Annan Takes First at Charlie Post Classic 15K
item.description: The annual Charlie Post Classic 15K Run, 5K Run and 5K Walk were held on Sullivan’s Island on Saturday, Jan. 24. The 15K race was won by Mount Pleasant resident Jason Annan, who finished with a time of 55:52.105.

item.title: Isle of Palms Fire Department Receives Fire Safe SC Designation
item.description: The City of Isle of Palms Fire Department has earned the Fire Safe SC designation for another year, recognizing the department’s commitment to fire prevention, public safety education and emergency preparedness.

item.title: Isle of Palms Recreation Department to Host Community Yard Sale
item.description: The Isle of Palms Recreation Department will host its annual Community Yard Sale on Saturday, March 21, from 8 to 11 a.m. at the Isle of Palms Recreation Center.

item.title: 2026 Isle of Palms Polar Plunge Set for Feb. 28 at The Windjammer
item.description: The 2026 Isle of Palms Polar Plunge benefiting Special Olympics South Carolina will take place Saturday, Feb. 28, from 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. at The Windjammer, located at 1008 Ocean Blvd.

item.title: Snowstorm This Weekend
item.description: A snowstorm is likely to affect South Carolina Friday night through Saturday night. A Winter Storm Watch is in effect for the entire state.

item.title: Lane Closure Notification
item.description: Please be aware of drainage improvement work taking place within the Station 28.5 and Station 31 neighborhoods south of Middle Street. This utility work may cause traffic delays due to lane closures over the coming months.

item.title: Weather Alert: Bitterly Cold Temperatures & Possible Snow
item.description: Based on the most recent National Weather Service report, there is a high probability of an Extreme Cold Warning going into effect over the weekend.

item.title: A Fluffy Weekend Ahead
item.description: A major snowstorm will affect all of South Carolina from Friday night into Saturday morning, and it will last into Saturday night or Sunday morning. The entire state is under a Winter Storm Warning.

item.title: 1/30 TOKI Weather Alert: Bitterly Cold Temperatures & Possible Snow
item.description: The Kiawah Island Emergency Management team along with our Charleston County partners are closely monitoring the winter storm. A Winter Storm Warning and Extreme Cold Watch are currently in effect for Charleston County.
